build_nvidia_nim_rerank_url: build the Nvidia NIM rerank API URL from api_base and model name
map_cohere_rerank_params_to_nvidia: map Cohere rerank params like top_n to Nvidia NIM format with top_k
transform_rerank_request_to_nvidia: transform rerank request to Nvidia NIM format with query object and passages array
transform_rerank_response_to_litellm: transform Nvidia NIM rerank response to LiteLLM standard RerankResponse format
validate_nvidia_nim_api_key: validate Nvidia NIM API key and build default authorization headers
